newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-VALENCIA AND FLAMENGO OPEN TRANSFER TALKS OVER ROMARIO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VALENCIA AND FLAMENGO OPEN TRANSFER TALKS OVER ROMARIO.

text.p: Valencia and Brazilian club Flamengo have opened negotiations over the possible transfer of troubled striker Romario.
Flamengo president Kleber Leite arrived in Spain on Sunday and has already made Valencia an offer for Romario, who has been dropped again by coach Luis Aragones.
"I've come for him and I won't return to Brazil if the player doesn't come with me," said Leite, who has offered to let a Flamengo player join Valencia on loan in exchange for Romario.
Unconfirmed reports on Monday suggested that Romario would travel to Brazil this week, his third trip home in the two months he has been at Valencia.
